# Copilot Instructions — Pointer to the Master Reference

**Last Updated**: 2026-06-05

> ⛔ **STOP. This file holds no rules.** It is a thin pointer to the **single master reference** for this repository.

## You MUST read and obey the master reference

**→ [`.hi/instruct.md`](../.hi/instruct.md) is the single authoritative master.**

Before reading anything else, taking any action, or suggesting any change, you **MUST** open [`.hi/instruct.md`](../.hi/instruct.md) and follow its **[⛔ Mandatory Reading Contract](../.hi/instruct.md#-stop--mandatory-reading-contract-non-negotiable)**. That contract — and only that contract — defines:

- the mandatory reading order (starting with [`.hi/dev-specs.md`](../.hi/dev-specs.md)),
- the cross-cutting canonical map (conventions, maintenance, credentials, environment),
- the depth-priority rule (**the deepest `.hi/instruct.md` always wins**),
- the governed import/merge guard (use [`/hip-route`](../.hi/prompts/tier-1/hip-route.prompt.md) / `/hip-import-execute`, never ad-hoc copies).

**Coexistence:** the `.hi/` system is a coherence-governance layer, **not** a replacement for your tools. GitHub Copilot's native behavior keeps working as usual — `.hi/` only governs the instruction system and the standing safety contracts. Ordinary source code in an adopting project is **not** governed scope: read, navigate, and investigate it freely. See [Scope, Authority & Coexistence](../.hi/instruct.md#scope-authority--coexistence-read-this-carefully).

**Do not** restate or duplicate the governance rules here. If a rule seems missing, it belongs in `.hi/` — add it there, not in this pointer.
